hadith:
Menstrual Periods - Narrated Zainab bint Abi Salama:

Um-Salama said, "I got my menses while I was lying with the Prophet (ﷺ) under a woolen sheet. So I slipped away, took the clothes for menses and put them on. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, 'Have you got your menses?' I replied, 'Yes.' Then he called me and took me with him under the woolen sheet." Um Salama further said, "The Prophet (ﷺ) used to kiss me while he was fasting. The Prophet (ﷺ) and I used to take the bath of Janaba from a single pot."
message:
# Spiritual Guidance

Just as Allah is Al-Ghaniyy—The Rich One, completely self-sufficient and independent—we are reminded through the example of the Prophet (ﷺ) to maintain compassion and closeness with our loved ones in all circumstances, understanding that true richness lies not in material wealth but in the strength of our relationships and faith. Let us reflect on the fate of those who turned away from truth throughout history, and ensure we do not become among the losers by neglecting our duties to Allah and to one another.
name:
Al Ghaniyy - الْغَنِيُّ - The Rich One

The name Al Ghaniyy emphasizes Allah's self-sufficiency and independence from any external support. It reassures believers that Allah is the ultimate provider, in contrast to human dependency and need. The concept originates from the Quran, where Allah is described as possessing all wealth and sufficiency, highlighting His greatness and the assurance to His creation.
verse:
Al-Ahqaf - The Wind-Curved Sandhills - 46:18

These are the ones against whom the fate of earlier communities of jinn and humans has been justified, ˹for˺ they were truly losers.
